description: (Li)₂NaCrF₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Li clusters inside a NaCrF₆ framework. In each Li cluster, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaCrF₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CrF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.16 Å. Cr is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form CrF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Cr-F bond lengths are 1.91 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Cr atom.
